durableEvidence.normalization: Original capture keys and all result values are retained. Capture-local file paths are mapped to unchanged durable repository files when saved; remaining capture-only absolute roots become <capture-root> or <scratch>. Compressed logs retain a historical capture path and receive an additive durableStorage binding: parent bytes/sha256 describe the uncompressed original, storedBytes/storedSHA256 the gzip file. The original capture is retained byte-exact inside deterministic gzip. Original subsidiary JSON, source inventory and logs are saved unchanged (logs use lossless gzip); any capture-local paths inside those originals are historical labels, not portable current locations.
durableEvidence.payloadPolicy: Full original job, runtime-build, optimized Swift, console and smoke-progress logs plus original JSON evidence are retained. Development app ZIPs and screenshot image bytes remain GitHub Actions artifacts with 14-day retention; hashes, archive inventories and screenshot reviews are durable. No production-release package is represented.
